notes.md: - **Local Boards:** **four** – Mumbai (West), Kolkata (East), Chennai (South), New Delhi (North); members appointed by the **Central Government** for **4 years**; each sends **one director** to the Central Board. Not functioning since 2022 for lack of quorum (a Standing Committee of the Central Board acts for them).
- **Abroad – Venezuela (Dec 2016):** President **Maduro** ordered the **100-bolivar** note, its largest, out of circulation; the deadline was put off after protests and cash shortages.
- **Taglines:** **Bank of India** – "Relationship beyond banking"; **Punjab National Bank** – "The name you can bank upon".
- **Syndicated loan:** one loan to a **single borrower** funded by a **group (syndicate) of lenders**; a **lead bank** (lead arranger) arranges and manages it.
